class.name: SwiftScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the Swift programming language, saved with the [code].swift[/code] extension (Swift-enabled builds only).
class.description: This class represents a Swift script. It is the Swift equivalent of the [GDScript] class and is only available in builds with the [code]swift[/code] module enabled ([code]module_swift_enabled=yes[/code]). Script execution additionally requires the Swift runtime library ([code]swiftgodot_runtime[/code]) to be found next to the executable or in [code]res://bin[/code]; without it, Swift scripts can be loaded and edited but not instantiated.
